boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, named TCU study environments with current official access details.

cards.title: First Floor Quiet Study Zones
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the library’s first-floor quiet zones when you need an individual place to read or draft; consult the floor plan before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A mapped quiet-study option on the library’s active first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Library’s building maps list Quiet Study Zones on the first floor.
cards.source_title: Building maps, locations and directions | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Located within Mary Couts Burnett Library; use the official first-floor map to locate the zones.

cards.title: Second Floor Quiet Study Zones
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · second floor
cards.notes: Choose a mapped second-floor quiet zone for focused reading, then use nearby library service desks if you need research support.
cards.short_summary: Quiet-study areas on the library’s main service level.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Library’s building maps list Quiet Study Zones on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Building maps, locations and directions | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Located within Mary Couts Burnett Library; use the official second-floor map to locate the zones.

cards.title: Third Floor Quiet Study Zones
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · third floor
cards.notes: Head to the third-floor quiet zones for reading or writing and use the official floor plan to identify the designated locations.
cards.short_summary: Mapped quiet zones on the library’s upper floor.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Library’s building maps list Quiet Study Zones on the third floor.
cards.source_title: Building maps, locations and directions | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Located within Mary Couts Burnett Library; use the official third-floor map to locate the zones.

cards.title: First Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · first floor
cards.notes: Plan a collaborative work session in a first-floor group room, and follow the library’s study-room reservation process before you go.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group-work rooms mapped on the first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Library maps show Group Study Rooms on the first floor, and the library provides a study-room reservation process.
cards.source_title: Study Room Reservations | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s room-reservation process; official building maps place group study rooms on the first floor.

cards.title: Second Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · second floor
cards.notes: Reserve a second-floor group room for shared coursework, then confirm the room location on the library’s official floor plan.
cards.short_summary: A reservable collaborative-study option on the second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU Library maps show Group Study Rooms on the second floor, and the library provides a study-room reservation process.
cards.source_title: Study Room Reservations | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the library’s room-reservation process; official building maps place group study rooms on the second floor.

cards.title: Student Success Center Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Samuelson Hall 001 · west entrance
cards.notes: Current undergraduates can reserve these rooms in advance for up to three hours daily; bring work that benefits from a TV or dry-erase board.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Student Success Center rooms with study supplies and presentation tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Current TCU undergraduates can reserve Student Success Center study spaces in Samuelson 001; rooms include TVs, dry-erase boards, study supplies, and snacks.
cards.access_notes: For current TCU undergraduate students; reserve in 30-minute increments, up to three hours per day, through the Student Success Center calendar.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · second floor east end
cards.notes: Work at a library computer in the Information Commons when your assignment needs campus software or a staffed computer-lab setting.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor computer lab on the library’s east end.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Commons computer lab is on the east end of Mary Couts Burnett Library’s second floor.
cards.source_title: Information Commons | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor’s east end; lab managers are available at desks in the Information Commons or nearby Library Services desk.

cards.title: GIGA Lab
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the GIGA Lab for coursework that calls for higher-level computing, and check whether your course is cleared for access before planning a session.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lab for high-memory and higher-processing computing work.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU describes the GIGA Lab as a first-floor library facility with hardware and software information and course-cleared access listings.
cards.source_title: Library Facilities: GIGA Lab | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s first floor and open during library hours; consult the current cleared-course list or student request form for access.

cards.title: Media Editing Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · first floor
cards.notes: Reserve one of the two media editing rooms when a class project needs audio or video production and editing rather than ordinary desk work.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable first-floor rooms for audio and video production.
cards.evidence_claim: Mary Couts Burnett Library offers two Media Editing Rooms for audio and video production and editing, available by reservation only.
cards.source_title: Media Editing Rooms | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; located on the library’s first floor and open during library hours.

cards.title: Special Collections Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · third floor
cards.notes: Contact Special Collections ahead of a primary-source research session so staff can help prepare relevant archival, manuscript, or rare-book materials.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor research room for working with TCU Special Collections materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The Special Collections reading room is on the third floor of Mary Couts Burnett Library, and TCU asks researchers to contact the department in advance for extensive research.
cards.source_title: About Us | Special Collections | TCU Mary Couts Burnett Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor. Contact Special Collections in advance, particularly for extensive research, so staff can discuss materials and visit planning.
